text:
dana: PR 24981 blocked by windows-integration failures on snapshot tests — looks intermittent. Can someone approve a targeted rerun or help triage? @luca maybe?
ci-bot: Build 5123 failed on windows-integration-shard-6
Failed tests: tests/integration/ui_snapshot_test::test_update_flow
Logs:
```
ERROR AssertionError: expected snapshot 'button-state-2' but got 'button-state-1'
File: tests/ui/snapshot_helper.py:78
Trace: AssertionError: snapshots differ
```
ryan: :eyes: saw this earlier, passed locally for me. Can we trigger a targeted rerun for shard-6? Command we use: `bk rerun --job windows-integration-shard-6 --build 5123`
samira: If it's flaky we should avoid snapshot updates without a repro. I'll start a bisect across the last 10 commits later today.
maya: I can approve a rerun if someone confirms it's not a codeowner snapshot change. @dana any UI rendering changes in this PR?
dana: No UI changes here — just kv cache tweaks and retry logic. Snapshot update would be wrong if it's a flake.
luca: Agree, don't update snapshots yet. @samira if you bisect and narrow it down ping me and I'll run expanded tests. Also set env `DEBUG_SNAP=1` on rerun to get richer logs.
samira: Starting bisect now, will post results here. ETA ~45m.
ryan: If bisect is slow, quick check: run the test many times on the windows image to get failure rate, e.g. `pytest tests/integration/ui_snapshot_test.py::test_update_flow -k update_flow -c 20` (or run a small loop 10-20x).
samira: Good idea — running 20x now, will attach failing trace if it reproduces.
ci-bot: Rerun request from maya queued: `bk rerun --job windows-integration-shard-6 --build 5123` (queued) :white_check_mark:
maya: :thumbsup: queued. If it fails again we'll escalate to SRE for infra flakiness.
samira: Repro'd once, attaching stack snippet:
```text
AssertionError: expected snapshot 'button-state-2' but got 'button-state-1'
File: tests/ui/snapshot_helper.py:78
Context: click -> render -> snapshot compare
```
Looks like intermittent state ordering, possibly timing.
luca: That points to non-deterministic ordering. Could be KV cache race under concurrency. Dana, can you add a tiny sleep in the test to validate timing hypothesis (in a debug branch)?
dana: I can add a test guard in a short-lived branch to confirm, won't land snapshot changes to main. Will reproduce locally against the suspect commit.
samira: Bisect narrowed it to commit 0c4f2a (merge from feature/kv-retry). Pinging @dana.
dana: That's mine, thanks — I'll reproduce against that commit and push a debug branch or fix.
ryan: If you need approvals to rerun more builds, @maya can approve. Reminder: snapshot updates require codeowner + QA signoff.
maya: Noted. Keep us posted and tag me when you have a repro or a candidate fix.
